name: Aeolodon
sum: Teleosaurid crocodyliform from the Late Jurassic (Tithonian) of Germany and France, first named as a Crocodylus species in 1814.
holotype: The holotype of A. priscus was found in the Mörnsheim Formation at Daiting, Bavaria, in the same quarry that yielded the Geosaurus giganteus holotype.
material: An assigned specimen comes from the Canjuers Lagerstätte, Var, France.
biology: The article consulted gives no information on its biology.
